text:
maria: Heads-up — security team is deploying a stricter keystore VPC ACL in eu-west-2 tomorrow 02:00 UTC. They flagged potential hits to keystore proxy from our GPU onboarding path. @vikram can you confirm which pools will be affected?
ops-bot: Automated change scheduled by @security: keystore-vpc-acl-tighten-euw2 at 2024-11-12T02:00Z. Change ID: CHG-20241112-198.
vikram: Looking now. gpu-pool-euw2-warmpool and gpu-spot-onboard subnet 10.20.32.0/24 talk to keystore via privatelink -> should be in scope.
jen: If the privatelink endpoints are behind the new ACL, joins will fail during handshake (observed before). Short failures, but causes join retries and delayed capacity.
tomas: We saw ~30% slower warmup last time when a similar ACL rolled. Errors were: `keystore:403 access denied` then node drains.
elyse: Cost note — slower warmup means longer warmup instances on, extra spot churn. Estimate ~6-12% cost bump for the region during the window.
maria: Proposed mitigation: 1) deploy narrow temporary allowlist for warmup subnets, 2) run a small canary (2 nodes) before full ACL, 3) have fallback route to shared-keystore in another AZ if canary fails. Thoughts?
vikram: +1 to allowlist + canary. Can we create allowlist via Terraform toggle so we can revert quickly?
jen: Yep, I can push a short-lived tfvar and plan. Suggest TTL 4h after change. Also add a cloudwatch alarm on keystore error rate > 5% for 10m.
tomas: Add a readiness probe change: if keystore handshake fails, probe should mark NotReady after 3 attempts (was 10) so we avoid long blackholes. That reduces noisy retries.
elyse: Also add cost guardrail: if warmup duration > baseline +20% alert to #cost-ops so we can pause onboarding.
maria: I'll own the ops playbook and rollback steps. Action items: @jen make tf change now, @vikram smoke test canary at 01:30 UTC, @tomas update readiness probe, @elyse add cost alarm.
ops-bot: Incident temp channel created: #temp/keystore-euw2-acl-canary (auto).
vikram: Quick smoke test note — test command: `curl -H "X-Node: warmpool-1" https://keystore-proxy.internal/v1/handshake` should get 200. If 403, don't proceed.
jen: TF change done in branch `keystore-euw2-allowlist-temp`, PR opened -> link: https://git.company/infra/pull/732.
maria: OK. We'll run canary at 01:30, monitor keystore error rate, warmup latency, and cost signals. If anything spikes, we rollback ACL and keep old policy. @here please be on standby around 01:15 UTC. :eyes:
vikram: On standby. Will also tail `gpu-join` logs: `kubectl -n infra logs -l app=gpu-join --since=30m`
tomas: Readiness probe PR merged. Will bump image tag to `gpu-join:20241112-canary`.
elyse: Cost alarm created and linked to PagerDuty runbook.
maria: Thanks team. Post-mortem notes: keep temporary allowlist under 4 hours. We should schedule a follow-up to discuss long-term keystore peering for warmup traffic.
vikram: Agreed — we should push for a dedicated keystore endpoint for warmup traffic to avoid future ACL churn.
jen: I'll close the PR after the TTL expires.
maria: Closing thread for now — will update after canary. :white_check_mark:
